title: SABLE: Scalable Affine Bayesian Latent-space Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2610.31495v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Complex objects such as engineering designs and proteins are often difficult to optimise because their design spaces exhibit high-dimensional structure and objective evaluations are expensive. Generative models provide continuous latent representations, but their latent spaces can have thousands to tens of thousands of dimensions, creating a regime where the latent dimension $D$ greatly exceeds the evaluation budget. We introduce SABLE, a Bayesian optimisation method for high-dimensional latent spaces with an isotropic distribution and limited budget. SABLE uses a Bayesian affine surrogate for prediction and acquisition, treating higher-order structure as surrogate discrepancy. After $N$ observations, the slope update has dimension at most $N-1$, yielding a decomposition of each query into an in-span component optimised by expected improvement (EI) in at most $N$ dimensions and an off-span component governed by a scalar norm. translated_title: SABLE：可扩展的仿射贝叶斯潜空间探索
translated_abstract: 诸如工程设计、蛋白质等复杂对象往往难以优化，因为它们的设计空间呈现高维结构，且目标评估代价高昂。生成模型提供了连续的潜空间表示，但其潜空间可能具有数千至数万维，形成了潜空间维度 D 远超评估预算的情形。我们提出 SABLE，一种针对各向同性分布且预算有限的高维潜空间的贝叶斯优化方法。SABLE 使用贝叶斯仿射代理模型进行预测与采集，并将高阶结构视为代理模型的偏差。在 N 次观测之后，斜率更新的维度至多为 N-1，从而将每个查询分解为一个至多 N 维的跨度内分量（通过期望改进 EI 进行优化）和一个由标量范数支配的跨度外分量。我们表明……
tldr: SABLE 提出了一种贝叶斯仿射代理优化方法，通过将查询分解为由期望改进（EI）优化的低维跨度内分量和由标量范数支配的跨度外分量，在评估预算远小于潜空间维度的高维潜空间中实现了可扩展的贝叶斯优化。
en_tdlr: SABLE introduces a Bayesian affine surrogate optimisation method that scales to high-dimensional latent spaces by decomposing each query into a low-dimensional in-span component optimised via expected improvement (EI) and a scalar-norm-governed off-span component, enabling Bayesian optimisation when the evaluation budget is far smaller than the latent dimension.
